description: List repositories for an owner, optionally filtered by active state, names or search. Codecov REST: GET /{service}/{owner_username}/repos/.

active.description: Filter to repos that are active (receiving coverage) or not.

names.description: Filter to specific repository names (each is sent as a repeated `names` query param).

owner.description: Owner username — the organization or user login on the git service, e.g. 'codecov' (required).

pageSize.description: Number of results per page (maps to `page_size`).

service.description: Git service provider — one of 'github' (default), 'gitlab', 'bitbucket', 'github_enterprise', 'gitlab_enterprise' or 'bitbucket_server'.

name: codecov_list_repos
title: List repositories
